description: TCS-off surface, safe generic SHOW. No dedicated surface-start signal is confirmed for TCSOFF in this integration; the framework-assigned TCSOFF state is evaluated in a normal powered-on condition. Show modeled with val_power==POWER_ON(3) and display enabled. No fabricated vehicle-condition warning is asserted because the vehicle-condition indicator (sta_vehicleConditionShow) is only driven by door status while val_gear==1.
